parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.

parameters.name: SystemType
parameters.description:
The operating system type. Valid values:

- **2**: Windows
- **1**: Linux
- **0**: all.
